retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast studio portrait against a solid black background featuring a central subject with large-scale, expressive white hand-lettered script and metallic textures.

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered female subject in metallic silver attire posed against a deep black void, characterized by sharp studio lighting that emphasizes skin texture and jewelry, overlaid with a large, energetic white script signature.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically with head tilted slightly upward
Large-scale script typography overlapping the subject's hair and background
High contrast between the dark background and bright metallic clothing
Visual weight balanced by small logos in the bottom corners
coreInvariants: Solid pitch-black background without environmental detail
Metallic or glitter-textured fabric on the subject
White gestural hand-lettering as the primary display element

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, captured from the mid-thigh up, occupying approximately 60% of the frame width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large white script signature on the right side.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves down to the jewelry, then sweeps right across the large script text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive solid black negative space surrounding the subject, providing high contrast for the white text.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the black background and the bright highlights on skin and fabric; low overall color saturation.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Gestural, expressive script with varying line weights
letterConstructionRules: Continuous, fluid strokes mimicking a marker or paint pen
Sharp, aggressive angles mixed with rounded loops
Overlapping characters that create a unified graphic shape
Inconsistent x-height for a raw, energetic feel
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital letters integrated into the flow of lowercase forms
Extended tails and flourishes that span the width of the composition
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair the expressive script with small, clean sans-serif metadata in the corners for a professional finish.
graphicDevices: Small heart icon integrated into the script

candidateDirections.reason: To maintain the unique, energetic flow of a personal signature.
To capture the raw, urban aesthetic if custom lettering is unavailable.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a woman in metallic silver clothing against a solid black background with sharp, high-key lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, white, hand-drawn signature-style script over the right side of the image, ensuring it overlaps the subject's hair.

verificationChecks: Does the script look hand-drawn rather than typeset?
Is the metallic texture of the clothing visible?
Is the text large enough to be a primary focal point?

adjustableVariables: Accent color (red heart vs. other small icons)

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp edges on the subject
Fluid, confident brush strokes in the lettering

postGenerationChecks: Check for clean separation between subject and black background
Ensure the white script is legible as a graphic element
Verify the metallic sheen on the clothing is prominent
Confirm the composition feels balanced despite the large text
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Solid Black Background + Metallic Texture + Large Hand-Lettered Overlay
